theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_smp_liminf_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (L : NNReal) (z : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (v : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Tendsto Φ (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 z) → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < 1 → ENNReal.ofReal |Φ h| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((L : ℝ) / (h * (1 - h / 2))) * v h) → ENNReal.ofReal z ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * v h) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
